fields.summary: Cart total shows $0.00 after applying discount code when cart has 3+ items

content.text: AC-1: With 3 or more items in the cart and a valid discount code applied, the order-summary total must equal subtotal minus the discount percentage, matching the pricing API response body.
AC-2: The displayed total must never render as $0.00 when the pricing API returns a non-zero total.
AC-3: Behaviour for carts with 1 or 2 items must remain unchanged (total already correct).
AC-4: Removing an item so the cart drops below 3 items must show the correct total without re-applying the code.
AC-5: The total shown in the order-summary panel and on the payment step must match.
Summary

Cart total displays "$0.00" instead of the discounted amount when the cart has 3 or more items and a discount code is applied. The user cannot tell what they will be charged. Proceeding to the payment step still shows $0.00 in the summary.
Environment
Production, Chrome 120, Windows 11. Also reproduced on Firefox 121.
Steps to Reproduce
Add 3 or more items to the shopping cart (subtotal > $50).
Apply discount code "SAVE20" (20% off the order).
Observe the cart total in the order summary panel.
Actual Result
Cart total displays "$0.00". Proceeding to payment still shows $0.00.
Expected Result
Cart total should show the original subtotal minus 20% (e.g. subtotal $60.00 -> total $48.00), matching the value returned by the pricing API.
Additional Info
Happens only when the cart has 3 or more items. Works correctly with 1-2 items.
Started after last Friday's deployment (v2.4.1). Was fine on v2.4.0.
No errors in the browser console.
The pricing API response (POST /api/v3/cart/price) shows the CORRECT discounted amount in its JSON body; only the on-screen total is wrong.
Removing one item so the cart drops to 2 items makes the correct total appear again immediately, without re-applying the code.
Reproduced on 5/5 attempts. Also reproduced by a second tester on Firefox 121.
Dev note: order-summary component reads total from a cached selector that is only invalidated for carts under 3 items. Likely a memoisation key bug introduced in v2.4.1.
